purpose: Current-session research-qualification policy. It is not execution authorization, an order instruction, a suitability conclusion, or a promise of cash or return.

current_state.reason: No finite cross-asset decision universe, approved portfolio risk budget or current-session item, market-quality, account, concentration and correlation packets.

effective_q_formula: q_effective_i = q_portfolio * q_risk_state * q_research_i * q_valuation_i * q_market_quality_i * q_concentration_i * q_account_i; any zero results in q_effective_i = 0.

freshness_policy.product_documents: current as of the validation date
freshness_policy.market_fields: captured in one China market session for the proposed research tranche; market timestamps may not be mixed across sessions
freshness_policy.trailing_history: 20 completed China-market sessions for spread, traded-value and relative-premium controls; 60 completed observations for the REIT correlation screen unless the documented structural-history exception is resolved as q=0
freshness_policy.distribution_fields: TTM settled distribution notices reconciled to a dated current market price and receipt/tax convention
freshness_policy.reit_nav_fields: latest disclosed NAV/date plus intervening project-event review; disclosed NAV is not treated as a live IOPV

premium_discount.candidate_valuation_tolerance_requiremen: Must be documented by product type. For public REITs it must account for latest disclosed NAV date and intervening project events; missing tolerance fails q_0.

spread.formula: current_spread_pct <= min(policy_hard_ceiling_pct_of_mid, all_in_cost_budget_pct, max(trailing_20_session_median_spread_pct * 1.5, trailing_20_session_median_spread_pct + 0.10 percentage points))
spread.all_in_cost_budget_requirement: Must include documented commissions, taxes and estimated market impact appropriate to the product. Missing budget fails q_0.

model_tranche_capacity.minimum_data_rule: All four inputs must be positive, same-currency and retained in the validation record. A missing or non-positive input fails q_0; zero observed depth is not replaced by traded value.
model_tranche_capacity.remainder_rule: Any notional above the capacity calculation is not deferred into another risk sleeve. A later independent validation is required before any model allocation can be considered.

dynamic_market_quality_controls.market_event_rule: Suspension, material product event, stale reference value, absent normal trading, unresolved abnormal premium/discount, or a source conflict sets q_market_quality_0 regardless of numerical thresholds.

cash_flow_accounting_controls.purpose: Reconcile cash distributions consistently with total return; this is not a cash-budget gate or sleeve-selection threshold.
cash_flow_accounting_controls.account_reconciliation_requirement: Holder-specific tax, fee, settlement and receipt-convention evidence must be retained whenever cash distributions enter total-return attribution. Missing evidence leaves the relevant attribution component unresolved; it may not be replaced by a headline yield.
cash_flow_accounting_controls.capital_repayment_like_component_rule: An issuer-labelled or economically similar capital-repayment component requires a separate ledger flag and predeclared accounting/tax treatment. It is not labelled investment return or double counted.
cash_flow_accounting_controls.cash_disposition_boundary: Retaining, withdrawing or taking no action is investor-directed and separately recorded. A later market allocation requires a fresh T1-to-T4 review; no automatic deployment is permitted.

concentration_and_correlation_controls.preapproved_asset_class_caps: none; all future caps require a frozen T2 candidate set and portfolio-risk approval
concentration_and_correlation_controls.correlation_rule: Missing, inadequate or structurally unreliable history does not establish independence; it requires a qualitative common-driver review and remains q_0 if unresolved. Numerical cluster caps must be set in the approved T4 risk budget rather than inherited from the retired fixed vector.
concentration_and_correlation_controls.cross_sleeve_overlap_rule: Before any T4 proposal, map direct equities, ETFs, REITs and sovereign/cash tools for common issuer group, industry, factor, property/rental, regulated revenue, customer, financing and rate exposures. An unresolvable map sets the affected candidate q_concentration_0.

required_checks: eligible institution or direct sovereign-bond identity
term and withdrawal or maturity terms
protected_liquidity.boundary: The reserve is the sole fallback destination; it is not a portfolio return guarantee.

511010.boundary: Five-year Treasury ETF exposure is not protected liquidity.

direct_equities.boundary: Open-universe membership, a stock screen or a dividend yield does not establish direct-equity eligibility.

510880.boundary: Index dividend yield does not establish ETF cash receipts.

public_reits.boundary: Candidate-pool membership, a historical distribution rate, a quarterly annualisation, or five tickers alone cannot pass this sleeve.

sovereign_or_cash_candidates.boundary: Cash tools are researchable but no product is assumed to meet the total-return objective.

risk_state_controls.measurement: DD_t = flow-adjusted current marked account value / flow-adjusted high-water mark - 1; a dated account record is required.
risk_state_controls.caution_action: q_risk_state_0_for_new_risk_allocation; pause scheduled risk tranches pending re-underwriting. Any cash disposition remains investor-directed and separately recorded.
risk_state_controls.risk_stop_action: q_risk_state_0_for_all_market_candidates; cancel unexecuted model proposals; require an incident and non-automatic de-risk/recovery proposal before any later approval. Any cash disposition remains investor-directed and separately recorded.
risk_state_controls.release_rule: Dated re-underwriting, independent risk approval, refreshed portfolio-risk-budget gate and fresh candidate evidence are all required. A market rebound or a distribution is insufficient.

failure_waterfall.substitution_rule: No automatic substitution into a higher-yield, leveraged, lower-credit, correlated or direct-equity candidate. A new candidate may be nominated only through a later T1-to-T2 research cycle.
failure_waterfall.reit_force_fill_rule: If REIT independence, correlation/overlap, or any required current field fails, the candidate remains q=0; no REIT allocation is force-filled.
failure_waterfall.risk_budget_rule: If the portfolio risk budget or drawdown-state gate fails, every market candidate remains q=0 regardless of a passed item-level screen.
failure_waterfall.retry_rule: A fresh complete validation is required at the next scheduled review. There is no catch-up trade, automatic allocation, or target-repair allocation. Cash disposition remains a separate investor-directed decision.

warnings: This policy cannot prove an annual minimum return.
Cash distributions are reconciled for total-return accounting and are not a separate target, qualification threshold, or promise.
No open-universe candidate is approved merely because it fits a product category; item and portfolio evidence must be current and independently reviewed.
